independent_transient_probe.details: Independently constructed raw-DEFLATE JSON-string envelopes at eight payload sizes, checked exact output-cap acceptance and one-byte-too-small rejection, and compared decoding to installed FastF1 _api.parse. Independently replayed a stream with repeated and regressing clocks at 55 integer cutoffs, then verified that an oversized future payload was excluded before decoding.
independent_transient_probe.persistence: The inline probe and stdout were transient tool execution, not saved artifacts. No probe source hash or stdout hash is claimed.

reviewed_properties: Bounded physical record reads and decompressed output before JSON parsing
Strict quoted JSON/base64/raw-DEFLATE envelope and decoded structure validation
Physical order and cumulative-maximum availability prevent regression backdating
Equal-clock and future payloads excluded before payload validation
Missing, null, zero and false remain distinguishable in raw packets
Full stream validity requires exhaustion; cutoff validity is separate
limitations: No actual downloaded pilot packet had been reviewed at this stage; the acquisition diagnostic must establish real envelope compatibility.
Archive-prefix availability does not prove historical client receipt time or source-sample alignment.
This is a parser review with synthetic checks, not evidence of predictive performance.
